description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectActivityAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing project activities within the OrangeHRM Time module. The class extends Endpoint and implements CRUD operations (list, create, retrieve, update, delete) for project activities, utilizing traits for service dependencies and defining validation rules and OpenAPI documentation annotations.
external_methods: # No specific external method calls identified, only class dependencies used

classes.name: ProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: A REST API class managing CRUD operations for project activities in OrangeHRM's Time module, providing endpoints to list, create, retrieve, update, and delete project activities with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a collection of project activities for a specified project, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project activity with parameters provided in the request body.

methods.name: setParamsToProjectActivity
methods.description: Sets parameters from the request to a ProjectActivity entity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing project activities, including filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getProjectIdParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the projectId URL parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified project activities after verifying their existence.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new project activity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting project activities.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific project activity by its ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single project activity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing project activity identified by ID with new parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a project activity.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for the request body during create or update operations, including ensuring the project activity name is unique.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Configures options to check for the uniqueness of project activity names within a project, ignoring self during update.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts project and activity IDs from URL attributes for internal use.
